body:
The relief arrives sideways and unscheduled.

Someone finds it not in the therapy but on the road trip, not in the talk but in the new practice, and the relief declines to explain itself.

With Uranus trine Chiron, people receive repair from an unplanned direction and find themselves able to accept it from any direction that works.

The door nobody was watching delivered what the planned one promised.

The route may not fit anyone's plan, and when the plan argues with what is working, the plan tends to deserve the loss.
